hypotheses.mechanism: short identities segment into fewer subword pieces than paths
hypotheses.statement: setting identity_scheme from SHORT_ID to DISPLAY_NAME improves identifier_fragmentation
setting glyph_policy from UNICODE_NATIVE to ASCII_TRANSLITERATION improves bpe_tokens_per_transition
setting record_separator from NEWLINE to NEWLINE_BLANK improves bpe_tokens_per_transition

hypotheses.mechanism: a sigil makes an identity lexically distinct at a token cost
hypotheses.statement: setting identity_sigil from NONE to PREFIX_SIGIL improves identifier_fragmentation

hypotheses.mechanism: the linearization decides how far apart two related records land
hypotheses.statement: setting graph_serialization from DFS_PREORDER to DEPENDENCY_LOCAL improves max_reference_span_tokens

hypotheses.mechanism: shorter role words cost fewer pieces
hypotheses.statement: setting role_word_length from FULL to ABBREVIATED improves bpe_tokens_per_transition

hypotheses.mechanism: laying a declaration out nearer the site that consumes it shortens the span the reader must carry
hypotheses.statement: setting context_order from DEPENDENCY_TOPOLOGICAL to DECLARATION_INDEX improves binder_use_distance_tokens
setting goal_identity_visibility from BOTH to NONE improves bpe_tokens_per_transition

hypotheses.mechanism: a per-state digest turns any silent alteration into a mismatch
hypotheses.statement: setting checksum_policy from NONE to PER_STATE improves detect_corrupt_identity

hypotheses.mechanism: restated information makes a dropped field inconsistent rather than merely absent
hypotheses.statement: setting redundancy_level from NONE to EXPLICIT improves detect_drop_field

hypotheses.mechanism: stating a relation as an edge decouples it from nesting depth
hypotheses.statement: setting tree_vs_graph_projection from TREE_NESTED to GRAPH_EDGE_LIST improves max_reference_span_tokens
setting binder_metadata from FULL to NONE improves bpe_tokens_per_transition
setting obligation_visibility from EXPLICIT_METAVAR_BLOCK to NONE improves bpe_tokens_per_transition

hypotheses.mechanism: record scaffolding decides whether exchanging two lines is recoverable
hypotheses.statement: setting syntax_family from INDENTED_TREE to PROSE improves detect_swap_records

hypotheses.mechanism: the goal's position decides how far the action sits from its target
hypotheses.statement: setting goal_position from AFTER_CONTEXT to FIRST improves premise_to_action_distance_tokens

hypotheses.mechanism: role words are emitted once per record, so their length multiplies
hypotheses.statement: setting lexicon_register from SYMBOLIC_ROLE to COMPACT_MNEMONIC improves bpe_tokens_per_transition

hypotheses.mechanism: carrying Lean's display spelling beside the identity doubles the identifier budget
hypotheses.statement: setting alpha_normalization from BOTH to PRESERVE_DISPLAY improves bpe_tokens_per_transition

hypotheses.mechanism: the linearization decides how far apart two related records land
hypotheses.statement: setting graph_serialization from DEPENDENCY_LOCAL to BFS improves max_reference_span_tokens
setting state_partitioning from BEFORE_AFTER_FULL to BEFORE_PLUS_DELTA improves bpe_tokens_per_transition
